note: Quantiles of Gamma(k, 1), which are chi-squared quantiles with 2k degrees of freedom, halved. Computed apart from the dashboard: for an integer shape the Gamma CDF is 1 - sum_{j<k} e^-x x^j / j!, summed in 60-digit decimal arithmetic (Python decimal) and inverted by bisection. The k = 1 row is -ln(0.975), -ln(0.025). The exact (Garwood) 95 % interval for a Poisson mean with k events is [q(.025; k), q(.975; k + 1)].
